registry_entry.why: 'Version 0.1' plus the Mistral 7B paper (Jiang et al., 2023). Instruct for the same reason as Llama. The chat template at this revision (updated 2025-07-24) accepts a system message by prepending it to the first user turn; earlier template versions rejected system messages.

protocol.purpose: Primary, paper-comparable. The paper defines pass@1 as passing all tests 'on its first attempt'; greedy decoding is the deterministic version of one attempt, and is how the EvalPlus leaderboard reports pass@1. This run also feeds the manual code-cleaning track.
